levers.description: Frozen at a flat 6% — adjusted later in the Review step
preamble: TENTATIVE AOP FORECASTER — FY28 Growth Assumptions
Enter growth % for each month. Individual division rows override the OVERALL rate. Leave blank to inherit OVERALL.
rows: 1. OVERALL row: The default growth % applied to ALL divisions unless overridden.
2. Division rows: Fill ONLY if that division should grow at a different rate.
3. Leave a division cell BLANK to inherit the OVERALL % for that month.
4. Example: OVERALL=6%, KIDS=8% → GM, LADIES, MENS, RETAIL grow at 6%; KIDS grows at 8%.
5. Values are in %. Enter 6 for 6%, not 0.06.

preamble: Store Actuals — FY27 Monthly Sales (Rs Lakhs, Apr'26 – Mar'27)
Values pulled from AOP master. Edit any cell to override. Engine recomputes division contribution % from these figures — Jun'26 % is carried forward for Jul'26 onward.

levers.description: Per store×division AOP overrides for any FY28 month, plus the Mar'27 actuals fallback

Apr'27..Mar'28 columns = direct AOP overrides — type any value to force that store×division×month's final forecast; leave blank everywhere else to let the engine compute it. Values in Rs Lakhs.
